title: Reusing Jackson's encoding buffers preserves the JSON stream
summary: After encoding one JSON object the recycler's acquisitions and returns now balance. Two successive NDJSON streams preserved an embedded quote and newline.

change.description: Both Jackson encoder families release the borrowed recycler after single-value encoding and after normal or exceptional termination of a Flux.

notes: A separate mapper decoded the actual bytes. The caller checks the pool after each synchronous subscription has unwound.
